issues.title: New data changes for P9
issues.body:
As we further develop the `SupportPanel`, we need to make some data changes.

* [x] Introduce `owner` for an asset, it will take a `role['uniqid']` value.  This allows players to focus on assets they own.  In a subsequent development phase we _could_ consider switch mapping "asset control" to reflect this issue, rather than the "controls" value in the `mapping` channel type.  But, we'd still need to indicate which role controls the remaining "un-owned" assets.
* [x] Introduce `condition` for perception - so other forces can have a (possibly mistaken) perception of the condition of an asset
* [x] Introduce lots more assets. For Blue we should probably have around 15 roles, each containing 5 assets. For Red it would be 5 roles with 30 assets each. For Green it would be 5 roles, with 10 assets each
* [x] introduce more complex "Land Orders" template.  Introduce arrays for multiple instances of "Own units" and "Other units"
* [x] Introduce more "orders" messages, following client provided template.
